text: Yes, the 2022 loss was corroborated by the independent reference. The loss area of 0.6 ha was observed in 2022 by the Hansen GFC dataset. The JRC GFC2020 reference agreed that the entire event area was mapped as forest in 2020, meeting the corroboration rule of at least 50% agreement. Additionally, the MGAP forest map confirmed that the event area was within native forest. Therefore, the loss event in 2022 is corroborated.
